correctness.rationale: The normalization and quantified domain match Mal 2022. A direct norming-pair convex-combination proof reduces all operator triples on real ell-one three to a single three-column real matrix inequality. The proof separates repeated and distinct sign classes; in the distinct-class case the omitted fourth sign is their oriented sum. Choosing the explicit dual displacement \(z=-y/6\) and applying Cauchy-Schwarz proves \(D\le5W/3\) for every real matrix. The integer witness satisfies \(AA^{\mathsf T}=9I_3\) and gives \(D^2=75\), \(W^2=27\), attaining \(3/5\). Reproducible checker exactly verifies 19683 ternary and 50000 seeded integer matrices, four sign-class relations and witness identities; finite checks corroborate, not replace, the universal proof.
